f1.quote: CrFeTaVW as the composition before Ta-to-Ti substitution

f2.quote: The principal computational baseline was conventional MD without MC atom swaps.

f3.quote: Mechanical alloying produced bcc-type solid solutions in both powders.

f4.quote: SPS was performed for 5 min at 1543 K/70 MPa

f5.quote: Laser-flash thermal diffusivity was measured under 0.05 bar He from 300 to 1000 K.

f6.quote: Simulations used periodic boundaries, an NPT ensemble at 1 atm, EAM/MIE interaction potentials, 4394 atoms for bcc or 4000 atoms for fcc cells, 6×10^6 time steps, and in hybrid MC an attempted unlike-atom swap every 10 MD steps

f7.quote: Hybrid MC swaps seek thermodynamically lower-energy chemical arrangements and produced lower potential energies than MD.

f8.quote: MC predicted enhanced W–W association and segregation in CrFeTiVW, especially around 1200 K, whereas segregation was less pronounced for CrFeTaVW.

f9.quote: Strongly negative Fe–Ta mixing enthalpy and atomic-size mismatch favor Fe2Ta Laves-phase formation during consolidation.

f10.quote: CrFeTaVW retained a bcc matrix (a≈0.312 nm) but also formed an Fe2Ta C14 Laves phase and V- and W-rich regions; CrFeTiVW exhibited two bcc-derived structures (a≈0.310 and 0.298 nm)

f11.quote: For thermal transport, multielement disorder shortens the phonon mean free path and lowers diffusivity relative to W and CuCrZr, while lattice expansion at increasing temperature lengthens the mean free path and causes a modest diffusivity rise.
